## Specification

### Component: ExpandingSearch

An icon button that grows into a search field. The width springs open, the input takes focus, and it folds back on blur when empty or on Esc. An optional results slot opens beneath it.

#### Anatomy
```
<div class="ui-xsearch [ui-xsearch-sm|lg]" role="search" style="--ui-xsearch-w: 280px">
  <div class="ui-xsearch-field" data-state="closed|open">
    <button class="ui-xsearch-toggle" aria-label="Search" aria-expanded>search icon</button>
    <input class="ui-xsearch-input" type="search" aria-label="Search">
    <button class="ui-xsearch-clear" aria-label="Clear search">x</button>        (open and non-empty)
    <kbd class="ui-kbd ui-xsearch-hint" aria-hidden>⌘K</kbd>                       (open, empty, shortcut)
  </div>
  <div class="ui-xsearch-results" data-state="open|closed">…results…</div>          (open, non-empty, results given)
</div>
```

#### Props
- `value` / `defaultValue` / `onValueChange`; `open` / `defaultOpen` (false) / `onOpenChange`.
- `placeholder` ("Search"), `label` ("Search"), `width` (number px or CSS length, default 280), `size` `sm | md | lg` (32 / 36 / 44px), `shortcut` (⌘K / Ctrl K, default false), `onSubmit(value)`, `results` (ReactNode), plus `HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>` and ref.

#### Visual rules
- Field: 1px `--ui-border-strong`, `--ui-background`, `--radius-md` (`--radius-lg` at `lg`), `--ui-shadow-xs` (none in dark), `overflow: hidden`, `box-sizing: border-box`.
- Closed width = height (square icon button, icon `--ui-foreground`); open width = `--ui-xsearch-w`, never wider than `100vw − 2rem`.
- Input: transparent, 14px, no native search chrome. Clear button 24px with `--ui-accent` hover. Open + focused: ring `0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent)`.
- Results panel: absolute under the field (`top: calc(100% + 6px)`, full width, `z-index: 30`), `--ui-surface-raised`, 1px `--ui-border`, `--radius-lg`, `--ui-shadow-md`, padding 4px, max-height 20rem scrolling.

#### Behaviour
- Click the icon, or ⌘K / Ctrl K (`shortcut`), expands and focuses the input (focus is set in an effect after the open state renders).
- The input has `visibility: hidden` and `tabindex=-1` until open; the hide is delayed by the spring duration on collapse so it never pops.
- Blur collapses only if the query is empty and focus left the whole component (the results count as inside). A typed query keeps it open.
- Esc: clears the query, collapses, and returns focus to the icon. Enter → `onSubmit(value)`.
- While open, mousedown on the icon / clear button is `preventDefault`ed so the field keeps focus (no blur-collapse race in Safari).
- Results mount with `usePresence` and `data-state`.

#### Motion
- **Width**: CSS transition `width var(--ui-spring-smooth-duration) var(--ui-spring-smooth)` (540ms, never overshoots) between the two fixed widths. Animating size is the information here.
- Input opacity 0 → 1 in 150ms starting 90ms after the field begins to grow; visibility switches at once on open and after 540ms on close.
- Closed press: field `scale(.94)` on `--ui-spring-snappy`. Clear button `ui-pop-in` 150ms.
- Results: `ui-pop-in` 380ms (4px rise, `--ui-pop-y: -4px`, blur clears) / `ui-pop-out` 160ms `--ui-ease-in`.
- **Reduced motion**: the field opens and closes instantly; focus, results and collapse rules are unchanged.

#### Accessibility
- Wrapper is a `search` landmark. Icon button: accessible name + `aria-expanded`. Input: `type="search"`, `aria-label`, `aria-controls` → results while mounted.
- Esc and blur behaviour as above; the shortcut hint is `aria-hidden`.

#### Acceptance checks
- Closed: field is 36×36 and the input is not focusable. Clicking the icon makes it ~280px wide with the input focused.
- Blurring while empty collapses it; blurring with text leaves it open.
- Esc clears and collapses with focus on the icon.
- Typing shows the results panel; clearing hides it.

### `ui/components/expanding-search/expanding-search.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import {
  forwardRef,
  useEffect,
  useId,
  useRef,
  useState,
  type CSSProperties,
  type FocusEvent,
  type HTMLAttributes,
  type KeyboardEvent,
  type ReactNode,
} from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { useComposedRefs } from '../../lib/compose-refs';
import { useControllableState } from '../../hooks/use-controllable-state';
import { usePresence } from '../../hooks/use-presence';
import { Icon } from '../../icons/icon';
import { Kbd } from '../kbd/kbd';

export type ExpandingSearchSize = 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';

export interface ExpandingSearchProps extends Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, 'defaultValue' | 'onChange' | 'onSubmit' | 'results'> {
  /** Controlled query. */
  value?: string;
  /** Initial query when uncontrolled. */
  defaultValue?: string;
  onValueChange?: (value: string) => void;
  /** Controlled expanded state. */
  open?: boolean;
  /** Initial expanded state when uncontrolled. Default false. */
  defaultOpen?: boolean;
  onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void;
  /** Input placeholder. Default "Search". */
  placeholder?: string;
  /** Accessible name of the button and the field. Default "Search". */
  label?: string;
  /** Expanded width: a number of px or any CSS length. Default 280. */
  width?: number | string;
  /** Height: 32 / 36 / 44px. Default `md`. */
  size?: ExpandingSearchSize;
  /** Press ⌘K (Ctrl K on Windows and Linux) to expand and focus. Default false. */
  shortcut?: boolean;
  /** Enter pressed in the field. */
  onSubmit?: (value: string) => void;
  /** Panel shown below the field while it is open and has a query (results, suggestions). */
  results?: ReactNode;
}

/**
 * ExpandingSearch — an icon button that grows into a search field. The width
 * springs open (smooth, no overshoot), the input takes focus, and it folds back
 * on blur when empty or on Esc. An optional results slot opens beneath it.
 */
export const ExpandingSearch = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, ExpandingSearchProps>(function ExpandingSearch(
  {
    value: valueProp,
    defaultValue = '',
    onValueChange,
    open: openProp,
    defaultOpen = false,
    onOpenChange,
    placeholder = 'Search',
    label = 'Search',
    width = 280,
    size = 'md',
    shortcut = false,
    onSubmit,
    results,
    className,
    style,
    onBlur,
    onKeyDown,
    ...props
  },
  ref,
) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useControllableState<boolean>({ value: openProp, defaultValue: defaultOpen, onChange: onOpenChange });
  const [value, setValue] = useControllableState<string>({ value: valueProp, defaultValue, onChange: onValueChange });
  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const composedRef = useComposedRefs(ref, rootRef);
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);
  const toggleRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement | null>(null);
  const focusAfterOpen = useRef(false);
  const resultsId = useId();
  const [modLabel, setModLabel] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const showResults = open && value.length > 0 && results != null && results !== false;
  const presence = usePresence<HTMLDivElement>(showResults);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open || !focusAfterOpen.current) return;
    focusAfterOpen.current = false;
    inputRef.current?.focus();
  }, [open]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!shortcut) return;
    const mac = /mac|iphone|ipad|ipod/i.test(navigator.platform || navigator.userAgent);
    setModLabel(mac ? '⌘K' : 'Ctrl K');
  }, [shortcut]);

  const reveal = () => {
    if (open) {
      inputRef.current?.focus();
      return;
    }
    focusAfterOpen.current = true;
    setOpen(true);
  };
  const revealRef = useRef(reveal);
  revealRef.current = reveal;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!shortcut) return;
    const onKey = (e: globalThis.KeyboardEvent) => {
      if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && !e.altKey && !e.shiftKey && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'k') {
        e.preventDefault();
        revealRef.current();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
  }, [shortcut]);

  const collapse = (restoreFocus: boolean) => {
    setOpen(false);
    if (restoreFocus) toggleRef.current?.focus();
  };

  const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    onKeyDown?.(e);
    if (e.defaultPrevented || !open) return;
    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (value) setValue('');
      collapse(true);
    }
  };

  const handleBlur = (e: FocusEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    onBlur?.(e);
    if (!open || value) return;
    const next = e.relatedTarget as Node | null;
    if (next && rootRef.current?.contains(next)) return;
    collapse(false);
  };

  const rootStyle = {
    ...style,
    '--ui-xsearch-w': typeof width === 'number' ? `${width}px` : width,
  } as CSSProperties;

  return (
    <div
      role="search"
      {...props}
      ref={composedRef}
      className={cn('ui-xsearch', size !== 'md' && `ui-xsearch-${size}`, className)}
      style={rootStyle}
      onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
      onBlur={handleBlur}
    >
      <div className="ui-xsearch-field" data-state={open ? 'open' : 'closed'}>
        <button
          ref={toggleRef}
          type="button"
          className="ui-xsearch-toggle"
          aria-label={label}
          aria-expanded={open}
          tabIndex={open ? -1 : 0}
          onMouseDown={(e) => {
            // While open, keep the focus in the field so the blur-collapse never races the click
            if (open) e.preventDefault();
          }}
          onClick={reveal}
        >
          <Icon name="search" size={16} />
        </button>
        <input
          ref={inputRef}
          type="search"
          className="ui-xsearch-input"
          value={value}
          placeholder={placeholder}
          aria-label={label}
          aria-controls={presence.mounted ? resultsId : undefined}
          tabIndex={open ? 0 : -1}
          autoComplete="off"
          autoCorrect="off"
          spellCheck={false}
          enterKeyHint="search"
          onChange={(e) => setValue(e.target.value)}
          onKeyDown={(e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.nativeEvent.isComposing) onSubmit?.(value);
          }}
        />
        {open && value && (
          <button
            type="button"
            className="ui-xsearch-clear"
            aria-label="Clear search"
            onMouseDown={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
            onClick={() => {
              setValue('');
              inputRef.current?.focus();
            }}
          >
            <Icon name="x" size={14} />
          </button>
        )}
        {open && !value && shortcut && modLabel && (
          <Kbd size="sm" className="ui-xsearch-hint" aria-hidden="true">
            {modLabel}
          </Kbd>
        )}
      </div>
      {presence.mounted && (
        <div id={resultsId} ref={presence.ref} className="ui-xsearch-results" data-state={presence.state}>
          {results}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
});
```

### `ui/hooks/use-controllable-state.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';

/**
 * State that can be controlled (`value` + `onChange`) or uncontrolled
 * (`defaultValue`). Every stateful component uses this so the two modes
 * behave identically.
 */
export function useControllableState<T>({
  value,
  defaultValue,
  onChange,
}: {
  value?: T;
  defaultValue: T;
  onChange?: (value: T) => void;
}): [T, (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => void] {
  const [internal, setInternal] = useState<T>(defaultValue);
  const controlled = value !== undefined;
  const current = controlled ? (value as T) : internal;
  const currentRef = useRef(current);
  currentRef.current = current;
  const onChangeRef = useRef(onChange);
  onChangeRef.current = onChange;

  const setValue = useCallback(
    (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => {
      const resolved = typeof next === 'function' ? (next as (prev: T) => T)(currentRef.current) : next;
      if (Object.is(resolved, currentRef.current)) return;
      currentRef.current = resolved;
      if (!controlled) setInternal(resolved);
      onChangeRef.current?.(resolved);
    },
    [controlled],
  );

  return [current, setValue];
}
```

### `ui/hooks/use-presence.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { animationsFinished } from '../lib/dom';
import { useIsomorphicLayoutEffect } from './use-isomorphic-layout-effect';

/**
 * Keeps an element mounted until its exit animation has finished.
 *   const { mounted, state, ref } = usePresence(open);
 *   {mounted && <div ref={ref} data-state={state} />}
 * CSS animates on [data-state="open" | "closed"]; nothing else is needed.
 */
export function usePresence<T extends Element = HTMLElement>(present: boolean) {
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(present);
  const ref = useRef<T | null>(null);

  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (present) {
      setMounted(true);
      return;
    }
    let cancelled = false;
    animationsFinished(ref.current).then(() => {
      if (!cancelled) setMounted(false);
    });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [present]);

  return {
    mounted: present || mounted,
    state: (present ? 'open' : 'closed') as 'open' | 'closed',
    ref,
  };
}
```

### `ui/icons/icon.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type SVGProps } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../lib/cn';
import { iconPaths, type IconName } from './paths';

export interface IconProps extends Omit<SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>, 'ref'> {
  /** Icon shape. */
  name: IconName;
  /** Pixel size (width and height). Default 16. */
  size?: number | string;
  /** Stroke width. Default 1.75. */
  strokeWidth?: number;
  /** Accessible label. Without it the icon is decorative (aria-hidden). */
  label?: string;
}

/**
 * Built-in stroke icon. Inherits `currentColor`.
 *   <Icon name="check" />   <Icon name="search" size={20} label="Search" />
 * Server Component–safe.
 */
export const Icon = forwardRef<SVGSVGElement, IconProps>(function Icon(
  { name, size = 16, strokeWidth = 1.75, label, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <svg
      ref={ref}
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width={size}
      height={size}
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden={label ? undefined : true}
      aria-label={label}
      role={label ? 'img' : undefined}
      focusable="false"
      className={cn('ui-icon', className)}
      // Static, library-owned SVG markup — never user input.
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: iconPaths[name] }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

export { iconPaths, type IconName };
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/lib/compose-refs.ts`

```ts
import { useCallback, type Ref, type RefCallback } from 'react';

type PossibleRef<T> = Ref<T> | undefined;

function setRef<T>(ref: PossibleRef<T>, value: T | null) {
  if (typeof ref === 'function') ref(value);
  else if (ref) (ref as { current: T | null }).current = value;
}

/** Merge several refs into one callback ref. */
export function composeRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  return (node) => {
    for (const ref of refs) setRef(ref, node);
  };
}

/** Memoised composeRefs for use inside components. */
export function useComposedRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  return useCallback(composeRefs(...refs), refs);
}
```

### `ui/lib/dom.ts`

```ts
/** True when rendering on the server (no DOM). */
export const isServer = typeof window === 'undefined';

/** Resolve once every animation on `el` (and its subtree) has finished. */
export function animationsFinished(el: Element | null, subtree = true): Promise<void> {
  if (!el || typeof el.getAnimations !== 'function') return Promise.resolve();
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    // Wait a frame so animations triggered by the state change have started.
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const anims = el.getAnimations({ subtree });
      if (!anims.length) return resolve();
      Promise.allSettled(anims.map((a) => a.finished)).then(() => resolve());
    });
  });
}

export function prefersReducedMotion(): boolean {
  return !isServer && window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches === true;
}
```

### `ui/styles/components/expanding-search.css`

```css
/* Expanding search ------------------------------------------------------------
   <div class="ui-xsearch [ui-xsearch-sm|lg]" role="search" style="--ui-xsearch-w: 280px">
     <div class="ui-xsearch-field" data-state="closed|open">
       <button class="ui-xsearch-toggle">search icon</button>
       <input class="ui-xsearch-input" type="search">
       <button class="ui-xsearch-clear">x</button>  <kbd class="ui-xsearch-hint">⌘K</kbd>
     </div>
     <div class="ui-xsearch-results" data-state="open|closed">…</div>
   </div>
   Closed it is a square icon button (height × height); open it is --ui-xsearch-w wide.
   The width transitions on --ui-spring-smooth; the input stays hidden (and out of the
   tab order) until the field is open.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@layer components {
  .ui-xsearch {
    --ui-xsearch-h: 2.25rem;
    position: relative;
    display: inline-flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    vertical-align: middle;
  }
  .ui-xsearch-sm { --ui-xsearch-h: 2rem; }
  .ui-xsearch-lg { --ui-xsearch-h: 2.75rem; }

  .ui-xsearch-field {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    width: var(--ui-xsearch-h);
    max-width: calc(100vw - 2rem);
    height: var(--ui-xsearch-h);
    overflow: hidden;
    border: 1px solid var(--ui-border-strong);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background-color: var(--ui-background);
    color: var(--ui-foreground);
    box-shadow: var(--ui-shadow-xs);
    transition:
      width var(--ui-spring-smooth-duration) var(--ui-spring-smooth),
      border-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      background-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      box-shadow var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      transform var(--ui-spring-snappy-duration) var(--ui-spring-snappy);
  }
  .ui-xsearch-lg .ui-xsearch-field { border-radius: var(--radius-lg); }
  .ui-xsearch-field[data-state="open"] { width: var(--ui-xsearch-w, 17.5rem); }
  .ui-xsearch-field[data-state="closed"]:active { transform: scale(0.94); }
  .dark .ui-xsearch-field,
  [data-theme-mode="dark"] .ui-xsearch-field { box-shadow: none; }
  .ui-xsearch-field:has(.ui-xsearch-toggle:focus-visible),
  .ui-xsearch-field:focus-within[data-state="open"] {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent);
  }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-xsearch-field[data-state="closed"]:hover { background-color: var(--ui-accent); }
  }

  .ui-xsearch-toggle,
  .ui-xsearch-clear {
    display: inline-flex;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 0;
    border: 0;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    cursor: pointer;
    outline: none;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  }
  .ui-xsearch-toggle { width: calc(var(--ui-xsearch-h) - 2px); height: 100%; }
  .ui-xsearch-field[data-state="closed"] .ui-xsearch-toggle { color: var(--ui-foreground); }
  .ui-xsearch-field[data-state="open"] .ui-xsearch-toggle { cursor: text; }
  .ui-xsearch-clear {
    width: 1.5rem;
    height: 1.5rem;
    margin-inline-end: 0.375rem;
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    animation: ui-pop-in var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-out) both;
    transition: background-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard), color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
  .ui-xsearch-clear:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent); }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-xsearch-clear:hover { background-color: var(--ui-accent); color: var(--ui-foreground); }
  }

  .ui-xsearch-input {
    flex: 1 1 0;
    min-width: 0;
    height: 100%;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0 0.5rem 0 0;
    border: 0;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--ui-foreground);
    font: inherit;
    font-size: var(--text-base);
    outline: none;
    appearance: none;
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    /* Hidden (and unfocusable) once the fold-back has finished */
    visibility: hidden;
    opacity: 0;
    transition:
      opacity var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      visibility 0s linear var(--ui-spring-smooth-duration);
  }
  .ui-xsearch-input::placeholder { color: var(--ui-muted-foreground); opacity: 1; }
  .ui-xsearch-input::-webkit-search-decoration,
  .ui-xsearch-input::-webkit-search-cancel-button,
  .ui-xsearch-input::-webkit-search-results-button,
  .ui-xsearch-input::-webkit-search-results-decoration { display: none; -webkit-appearance: none; }
  .ui-xsearch-field[data-state="open"] .ui-xsearch-input {
    visibility: visible;
    opacity: 1;
    transition-delay: 90ms, 0s;
  }
  .ui-xsearch-hint { margin-inline-end: 0.5rem; animation: ui-fade-in var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-out) both; }

  /* Results slot */
  .ui-xsearch-results {
    --ui-pop-y: -4px;
    position: absolute;
    inset-inline: 0;
    top: calc(100% + 0.375rem);
    z-index: 30;
    max-height: 20rem;
    overflow: auto;
    padding: 0.25rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--ui-border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    background-color: var(--ui-surface-raised);
    color: var(--ui-surface-raised-foreground);
    box-shadow: var(--ui-shadow-md);
  }
  .ui-xsearch-results[data-state="open"] { animation: ui-pop-in var(--ui-duration-slow) var(--ui-ease-out) both; }
  .ui-xsearch-results[data-state="closed"] {
    animation: ui-pop-out var(--ui-duration-exit) var(--ui-ease-in) both;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
}

/* Reduced motion: the field opens and closes instantly; the input still appears and takes focus */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .ui-xsearch-field[data-state="closed"]:active { transform: none; }
  .ui-xsearch-input { transition-delay: 0s, 0s; }
}
```

## Usage

**Docs search** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/expanding-search/docs-search.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@/ui/components/button';
import { ExpandingSearch } from '@/ui/components/expanding-search';
import { Icon } from '@/ui/icons/icon';

const pages = ['Button', 'Dialog', 'Dropdown menu', 'Date picker', 'Data table', 'Input', 'Tabs', 'Toast', 'Tooltip'];

export default function ExpandingSearchDocsSearch() {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const matches = pages.filter((p) => p.toLowerCase().includes(query.trim().toLowerCase()));

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-64 w-full max-w-md items-start justify-between gap-4">
      <span className="pt-2 text-sm font-medium">Components</span>
      <ExpandingSearch
        shortcut
        placeholder="Search components"
        label="Search components"
        width={260}
        value={query}
        onValueChange={setQuery}
        results={
          <ul className="flex flex-col" aria-label="Results">
            {matches.length ? (
              matches.map((name) => (
                <li key={name}>
                  <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" className="w-full justify-start" onClick={() => setQuery('')}>
                    <Icon name="file" />
                    {name}
                  </Button>
                </li>
              ))
            ) : (
              <li className="px-3 py-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">No components match “{query}”.</li>
            )}
          </ul>
        }
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```
